high_level_description: The image is a news snippet from the Hindustan Times, featuring two photographs and accompanying text. The car's interior is partially visible, showing a beige-colored seat and part of the dashboard. The scene suggests that the car has been vandalized or damaged by something thrown at it. Right Photograph: This is a photo of a man standing outdoors.
